description:
## Current delivery contract — user-approved two-outcome stack
Owner: PR B. One PR per complete outcome, NOT one PR per bead. Keep detailed beads and cohesive internal commits for tracking; consolidate existing draft foundations into their owning feature PR where practical. PR B stacks on independently usable PR A. Include owning PR documentation and validation there. This supersedes earlier per-bead/prerequisite PR instructions and historical comments. Closed foundation status is not outcome acceptance.
New-feature E2E requires explicit human UX approval in zaq-emb.32; no self-approval.

Persistent consolidated feature E2E, PR B partition. Author only after explicit B UX approval, not A approval. Cover user-visible live activity incorporation, no cross-Person leakage or duplicate context, busy/finalizing requests not lost, ordered intermediary/final delivery and delayed timeout outcome. Cursor invariants, tool-call pairing, synchronization acknowledgment and denied/revoked reads also need deterministic integration/property tests before implementation. Reuse existing journeys and real internal boundaries, mock external LLM/transport only. Include B results in B; never block A E2E on this partition.
title: [zaq-emb.13.2] PR B live-execution and completion E2E
